name: Fire Extinguisher
summary: Portable device for putting out small fires before they spread.
education: Most home extinguishers are dry-chemical ABC units. The pressure gauge tells you if it is still charged. The powder inside can settle and cake if not shaken occasionally. Many have a 6-12 year lifespan from manufacture.

questions.prompt: Manufacture date (stamped on the bottom or label)?

suggested_photos.prompt: Label with class, weight, and manufacture date

maintenance.why: If the needle drops out of the green, the unit may not discharge in a fire.

maintenance.action: Shake or invert to loosen the powder
maintenance.why: Caked powder can clog the discharge nozzle.
Internal parts and seals weaken with age regardless of pressure.
